subject: Clarify: Current SOC 2 package + interim bridge for procurement acceptance
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 — need latest report and any bridge for expired period

Hi Mina,

We're onboarding Redwood as a vendor and our procurement/security teams asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II package and any bridge/interim attestation if the latest report doesn't fully cover our contract start date. We have a hard cutover date of 2025-11-01 in the SOW and need evidence that covers through that date (or a bridge that explains coverage).

I found a document titled "Redwood_SOC2_2024-10-01_to_2025-09-30.pdf" in the portal, but our security reviewer says it's expired relative to the SOW. Can you confirm which package we should accept and whether Redwood has reissued or provided a bridge letter?

Thanks — Lena
Lena Ortiz
Security Operations, Acme Corp
Lena.Ortiz@acme-corp.com

(attachment: none)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 — need latest report and any bridge for expired period

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and for flagging the SOW effective date. Quick answers up front:

- The file you found (Redwood_SOC2_2024-10-01_to_2025-09-30.pdf) is the Type II report covering that audit period and it does end 2025-09-30.
- We do have a current reissue path: for procurement workflows we provide (a) the latest Type II report when available, (b) a bridge letter attesting to continuity of controls through a later quarter if the most recent report's end date precedes a contract effective date, and (c) an evidence index.

To avoid back-and-forth: can you confirm whether Acme needs the report that explicitly covers through 2025-11-01 (SOW start) or whether a bridge + evidence index is acceptable to your risk team? If you can share the procurement reviewer name and a short list of acceptance criteria we can attach the exact PDFs.

Cc'ing Olga (security lead) and Karthik (compliance/product) to pull the correct package.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: none)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 — need latest report and any bridge for expired period

Hi Lena — Olga here. Thanks for the context. I attached the procurement-ready package in a single ZIP and a short bridge letter we provide for cases where the report end date is earlier than the contract start date. Summary:

- Attached: SOC2-TypeII-2025-package.zip (contains the full Type II report PDF, auditor attestation, and an evidence index CSV).
- Attached: bridge-letter-2025-Q3.pdf (a one-page letter from our auditor confirming no material control changes since the last op period and extending reliance language through 2025-11-30).
- The evidence index (evidence-index-2025.csv) maps sample control evidence to artifacts in the ZIP.

Important clarifications so Acme's reviewer can accept the package:
1) The auditor reissued an addendum (not a full re-audit) to document a minor administrative correction; the content and control conclusions did not change. The filename in our portal "Redwood_SOC2_2024-10-01_to_2025-09-30_v1.1.pdf" may look like a new version — it is an administrative reissue.
2) The bridge letter covers control continuity through 2025-11-30. That gives a 29-day buffer beyond your SOW effective date of 2025-11-01.
3) If Acme requires a full Type II report that lists 2025-11-01 within the auditor's stated period (instead of a bridge), we can discuss expedited re-audit scheduling, but that is slower and typically not required for procurement sign-off.

I've included the Drive link for your security reviewer to download individual artifacts if they prefer not to use the ZIP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkSOC2

Please confirm whether the bridge + package is acceptable and who on Acme's side will record acceptance.

Attachments:
- SOC2-TypeII-2025-package.zip (zip, 12MB)
- bridge-letter-2025-Q3.pdf (pdf, 130KB)
- evidence-index-2025.csv (csv, 42KB)

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com

> > Best, Mina

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>

Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 — need latest report and any bridge for expired period

Hi Olga,

Thanks — the package + bridge letter look good for our purposes. Our security reviewer (Samir Patel) confirmed the bridge through 2025-11-30 is acceptable as long as the evidence index maps to artifacts and the auditor's addendum is included. We'll mark this as accepted in our procurement tracker and proceed with contract signature.

Two small asks: can you add the HubSpot company record link or our Procure ID to the ZIP metadata (we need to tie artifacts to ACME-98765) and make the bridge letter name include our company name (Acme Corp) for our folder naming standards? If you can push a quick update, we'll close the loop today.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Lena
Security Operations, Acme Corp
